description: This file defines the 'IdSpanCodec' class responsible for serializing and deserializing 'IdSpan' instances within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for writing and reading 'IdSpan' objects directly or as part of a field in serialized data, utilizing a buffer writer and a reader.

classes.name: IdSpanCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing the 'IFieldCodec<IdSpan>' interface, providing serialization and deserialization methods for 'IdSpan' objects.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an 'IdSpan' value into a writer with field framing, including handling empty spans.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes an 'IdSpan' value directly into a writer without field framing.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Deserializes an 'IdSpan' value directly from a reader without field framing.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads an 'IdSpan' value from a reader, ensuring wire type correctness and handling payload.
